request.initial_prompt: Antony. 'Tis well blown, lads. This morning, like the spirit of a youth That means to be of note, begins betimes. So, so. Come, give me that. This way. Well said. Fare thee well, dame. Whate'er becomes of me, This is a soldier's kiss. [_Kisses her._] Rebukeable And worthy shameful check it were, to stand On more mechanic compliment. I'll leave thee Now like a man of steel.—You that will fight, Follow me close, I'll bring you to't. Adieu.
